name: The RMR Group Inc.
summary: The RMR Group Inc., through its subsidiary, provides real estate asset management services in the United States. The company offers management services to publicly traded equity real estate investment trusts; diversified healthcare trust, which owns senior living communities, medical office and life science properties and other healthcare related properties; industrial logistics properties trusts that owns and leases industrial and logistics properties; office properties income trust which owns and leases office properties primarily to single tenants and those with high credit quality characteristics; and service properties trust.
